title: Template Mosaic: reference app screenshot set + onboarding diagrams
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a cohesive set of visual assets and README diagrams for the new 'Mosaic' reference template app used in onboarding flows. Deliverables include annotated desktop + mobile screenshots, an export-ready Figma file, a lightweight SVG architecture/flow diagram for README, and short GIF walkthroughs for two key flows (setup + first inference). Assets must be production-ready for docs.redwood.com and the console onboarding modal.
acceptance_criteria: Hero desktop screenshot (1440x900) exported as PNG + 2x retina version and optimized for web (<=150KB)
Mobile screenshot set (375x812) for iPhone layout and Android variant with consistent safe-area framing
Annotated overlays for four key UI callouts (model selection, batch settings, streaming toggle, cost estimator) provided as separate SVG layers and flattened PNGs
README flow diagram delivered as editable SVG + exported PNG (light and dark theme variants)
Figma source file link provided with componentized frames and an assets page listing export filenames
Two short GIFs (12–18s) showing 'create new project' and 'deploy reference model' flows, max 3MB each
Copy for alt-text and short captions provided for each image (for accessibility and docs metadata)
Design handoff notes posted to the ticket with export command snippets and recommended placement in docs
assets_checklist: figma: Mosaic / Onboarding / Assets (link in links field)
style_guidelines: Use Inter for headline labels (600) and Inter 400 for annotations
Callout boxes: 8px radius, 2px stroke #0F172A at 12% alpha on light backgrounds
Annotation pointer arrows: solid 2px with 6px arrow head; use accent color #0066FF
Drop shadows: subtle (Y 6px, blur 18px, rgba(2,6,23,0.06)) applied to desktop hero only
Dark theme: invert diagram fills and use #E6EEF8 for highlighted areas
Maintain 48px vertical rhythm for screenshot safe zones to match docs layout
export_instructions: Name exports with lowercase, hyphenated pattern: mosaic-<asset>-<width>x<height>@<scale>.<ext>
Prefer PNG for screenshots, SVG for overlays/diagrams, GIF for short walkthroughs (optimize with gifsicle)
Produce 1x and 2x PNGs for all raster screenshots; target <=150KB for desktop hero and <=120KB for mobile
Flatten overlays for final web versions but include separate SVG layers in the assets ZIP for future edits
Include a small JSON manifest in the Drive folder (manifest.json) listing filename, caption, and alt-text (we'll paste captions into docs frontmatter)
